sn35.115:1.1: Santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || ||
sn35.115:1.2: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati ||
sn35.115:1.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu baddho cakkhuviññeyyesa rūpesu āvāsagato Mārassa Mārassa vasaṃgato
sn35.115:2.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu baddho manoviññeyyesu dhammesu āvāsagato Mārassa Mārassa vasaṃgato
sn35.115:3.1: Santi ca kho bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā- -rajaniyā || ||
sn35.115:3.2: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivādati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati ||
sn35.115:3.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu mutto cakkhuviññeyyehi rūpehi na āvāsagato Mārassa na Mārassa vasaṃgato ||
sn35.115:4.3: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati ||
sn35.115:4.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu mutto manoviññeyyehi dhammehi na āvāsagato Mārassa na Mārassa vasaṃgato
